passes.captionZh: 大提琴和低音提琴先拉出一组八个音的低音，整首曲子它都不变
passes.captionEn: Cellos and basses lay down eight bass notes; they repeat the whole piece

passes.captionZh: 第一小提琴进来；后面每一组，第二小提琴都会照着它拉一遍
passes.captionEn: First violins enter; each line they play, the seconds will copy one round later

passes.captionZh: 中提琴也跟进，三条线像轮唱一样追着走
passes.captionEn: The violas follow: three lines chasing each other like a round

passes.captionZh: 长笛和双簧管加进来，圆号托着长音
passes.captionEn: Flute and oboe join; the horns hold long notes

passes.captionZh: 最后一轮：全团一起，慢慢收住
passes.captionEn: Last round: everyone together, slowing to the end

passes.captionZh: 尾声：一个 D 大调的长和弦
passes.captionEn: Coda: one long D major chord

str.zh: 低音一直重复同一组八个音；三组小提琴、中提琴照着同一条线一前一后地追。
str.en: The bass repeats the same eight notes; violins and violas play one line, each a round behind.

ww.zh: 后半段长笛和双簧管加进来，跟着弦乐的旋律走。
ww.en: In the second half flute and oboe join the string lines.

br.zh: 圆号只吹长音，把和声垫厚。
br.en: The horns only hold long notes, thickening the harmony.

perc.zh: 这首没有打击乐，打击乐手在休息。
perc.en: No percussion in this one: the percussionists are resting.
